$comment: Account-level blocklist for the retired datapack programme. Enforced by scripts/datapack_guard.py in pre-commit, pre-push and CI, and mirrored org-wide by vortaforge/.github. Read blocklist/README.md before editing. Every entry needs: id, reason, added_on, added_by, enforcement.

managed.$comment: Accounts here are never matched by any rule. The maintainer's own accounts (tickwarden = Legends11, org owner; legends11) live here, not in `blocked`: they stopped shipping datapacks in 2026-11-05 but keep maintaining the Fabric mods, so blocking them would lock the maintainers out of their own repository. `ironcrest` is NOT here - it is a different person (id 204314210) and is not a maintainer.

blocked.reason: Automation and bot accounts must not author datapack content or reviews.
blocked.notes: Matches logins ending in [bot], -bot, _bot or .bot. Managed bots are exempt.

blocked.reason: AI agent and AI-assistant accounts are blocked from authoring this repository.
blocked.notes: Matches logins containing copilot/claude/chatgpt/openai/gemini/grok/codex/anthropic, or an ai/agent/automation/devlop token between separators.
